rationale: Two calibrated-view elbow flexion agrees with marker capture to about 2-6 deg RMSE (reports/3D upper body pose estimation.md); 5 deg is the tightest margin that error budget allows. Change only by a new commit made before analysing a take.
primary_claim_rationale: Chosen before any real take was analysed (simulation, 2026-10-29): the RMS difference over the sign covers time-varying disagreement that a mean can hide, and unlike a pointwise whole-curve band it is reachable with ~2 px detector noise. Mean and whole-curve results are always reported alongside.
